THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
015
STUDY 002
Golden Hour Street Selfie
Rights check
Source: 4564.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
A candid, arm's-length selfie of a young woman on a
city street at golden hour, framed vertically. She has
loose, shoulder-length honey-blonde hair with soft
face-framing waves and wears a beige trench coat over
a dark top with a delicate layered gold necklace. Low,
warm sunlight creates a glowing rim light on her hair
and a soft peach wash across her skin. Behind her, a
tree-lined street with parked bicycles, cream-colored
building facades, and a long shadow stretching across
the pavement. Shallow, natural depth of field, warm
amber, honey, and peach palette, relaxed and
sun-kissed, with a nostalgic summer feel typical of a
casual social media photo.
Candid, sun-kissed, casual social media
WORKING NOTES
- Good candidate for a mood board or social post.
- Variations: different season or city, more painterly
treatment.
